Test that prerender nested cross-origin iframe navigations receive status updates
{
    pipelineIdIndex:0
    url : http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/prerender/resources/cross-origin-iframe-prerender-nesting.php?prerendering

      status : Pending,
      status : Running,
      status : Ready,
      status : Success,
    }
}

}
